response.rationale: Both forms are valid standard adjectives matching “optimistic” and the sense “expecting favorable results.” The relation is similar rather than a false-friend contrast. Indonesian and Malaysian also share the form “optimis,” so the contrast should not be interpreted as exclusive, but this omission does not make the card materially misleading.
